_README: The only file you edit after setting Square up. Paste the values Square gives
you, save, then run build.ps1. Leave a value as an empty string and the site
falls back to the phone and text flow, so a half finished setup never ships a
dead button.
bookingUrl        Appointments > Online Booking > Channels > Get URL.
embedHtml         Same screen > Get embed code. This is the PUBLIC booking
flow for one off customers. Goes on book.html.
memberEmbedHtml   An ADVANCED WIDGET scoped to the single 'Plan visit'
service. Goes on welcome.html, which only members reach.
Plan visit must have Online Booking Visibility turned OFF
so it never shows on the public booking site.
plans.*           Payments > Subscriptions. One plan per cadence, each with a
checkout link (https://square.link/u/XXXXXXXX). On each link
turn ON 'Redirect to a website after checkout' and point it
at  <your domain>/welcome.html
Paste embed snippets on one line with every double quote escaped as \"
